environment.network: Local Vite production preview; no network emulation

methodology.fullDOM: Production React. GFM only, native code, identical neutral CSS. No virtualisation, animation, highlight or deferred rendering. Fresh page per trial, two small warmups, alternating order. Each synchronous flushSync commit includes forced layout; one rAF between chunks; separate final=true commit included. CDP TaskDuration also captures asynchronous browser work. Final semantic DOM compared to react-markdown + remark-gfm outside timing. JS heap measured after CDP GC, not total process memory.
methodology.reading: Independent cold browser context per renderer, production build, renderer default plugins/options and vendor CSS. LiMR default Markdown + full styles including Maple; Markstream default MarkdownRender + CSS with optional stream-diffs and KaTeX installed. Real local images; unique code/math. First readable frame is a two-rAF DOM-readiness proxy, not FCP/LCP. Compositor wheel gesture over 7 seconds, then middle/end seeks. Scroll rAF telemetry excludes snapshot scans and GC. Resource totals are measured local transfers, not npm installation or compressed bundle sizes.
